about: Tris Surf Shop and School is on Porthtowan Beach on Cornwall's north coast and describes itself as the home of Porthtowan surfing for over 40 years. Alongside the shop, it runs a surf school and surf hire. A tourism listing describes surf lessons, beginner surf camps and board and wetsuit hire.
season: May to September (from a third-party listing)
gaps: Homepage has little detail on lessons or hire; the lesson types and season come from a third-party listing; no ages, inclusions, booking terms or accreditations
